1.name: C
1.text: Look, there’s some freaks out there who don’t just buy their stuff and go on living their life. They actually want to TALK to us.

2.name: C
2.text: So, take their order, and humor them for a bit afterwards, got it?

3.name: C
3.text: They’re still paying clients, so you gotta tolerate some half-assed small talk

4.name: H
4.text: Oh, good afternoon to you, young lady!

5.name: H
5.text: I’ll just have the “orange juice and hot lunch combo”, please!

6.name: C
6.text: Oh yeah, forgot to mention. Some people aren’t satisfied with what we have easily laying around the shelves at this convenience hell-cube...

8.name: C
8.text: Look, I’ll give you some computer time today, but you’re gonna have to eat all your vegetables at dinner, okay?

9.name: C
9.text: So you can access the special items on your monitor over there.

10.name: C
10.text: They’re separated by categories, so use your brain.
